example.title: House, 1316 Bass Avenue, East Campus Historic District

brief: Two-and-a-half-storey Queen Anne in white clapboard in a student neighbourhood: a canted corner bay rising into a turret with a tall brown shingled spire, steep front and side gables with shingled tympana and small attic windows (one with a leaded star pattern), and a big curved wraparound porch on turned posts with a lattice skirt. Brown asphalt roof; iron-railed side steps; wide lawn and overgrown foundation shrubs - the look of a long-time rental.
